let src := Read_GPR(context.rex_r4 ++ context.rex_r3 ++ reg, operand_size);

read_instr.code: let disp8n := 1;
let (ea_offset, segment, next_ip0, is_rip_relative) := Effective_Address?(address_size, context, mod, rm, disp8n, ip);
let src := Read_GPR(context.rex_r4 ++ context.rex_r3 ++ reg, operand_size);
let effective_address := Handle_RIP_Relative_Address(address_size, is_rip_relative, ea_offset, next_ip0);

pre_execute.code: let old_dest := Logical_Mem_Read?(segment, effective_address, operand_size, access_type=>Memory_Read_Modify_Write);

execute.code: let (result, write_result) := Instr_CMPXCHG(operand_size, old_dest, src, is_mem_operand);

operation.name: CMPXCHG
operation.code: let (difference, carry_out, overflow, alternative_carry) := Subtract(accumulator, old_dest);
// Rewrite the "old_dest" value to the destination only when the destination is a memory operand.
// In case of register destination operand there is no need to rewrite the register with the same
// value as the upper 32-bits of the register will get cleared when operand_size == 32.

read_instr.code: let old_dest := Read_GPR8(context.rex_b4 ++ context.rex_b3 ++ rm, (context.rex_prefix_present or context.rex2_prefix_present or context.vex_prefix_present or context.evex_prefix_present));
let src := Read_GPR8(context.rex_r4 ++ context.rex_r3 ++ reg, (context.rex_prefix_present or context.rex2_prefix_present or context.vex_prefix_present or context.evex_prefix_present));

execute.code: let (result, write_result) := Instr_CMPXCHG(operand_size, old_dest, src, is_mem_operand);

post_execute.code: Write_GPR8(context.rex_b4 ++ context.rex_b3 ++ rm, (context.rex_prefix_present or context.rex2_prefix_present or context.vex_prefix_present or context.evex_prefix_present), result);

footnote.para: A locked read-modify-write memory access is performed.
With a REX prefix in 64-bit mode, attempts to access AH, BH, CH, or DH will instead access SPL, DIL, BPL, or SIL, respectively.
